lastCompletedStory.title: Fix .cam-orch-ready timing race (fixes C4: marker written by orchestrator, not by parent)

nextStoryContext: US-FIX-005 done. The .cam-orch-ready marker is no longer written by the parent process in setupPanes(); it is now written by the orchestrator agent as its FIRST action (instructed in buildOrchestratorBootPrompt). The SIGINT/SIGTERM cleanup in runRun still removes the marker on abnormal parent exit (idempotent: already-gone is a no-op). The bootstrap-wait helper (waitForOrchestrator) already re-validates liveness after seeing the marker, no change needed there. 917 tests pass. Check prd.json for the next pending story.
